manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Werefox Bodyguard, and Faceless Butcher must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Faceless Butcher for its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
